Blackheath had led from stage 3 and must have thought they had the race in the bag but Chelmsford's Keith Cullen believed otherwise and flew round for the 3rd best clocking of all time, taking his Essex team to victory.

Justin Chaston fought off the tenacious Keith Cullen to take the steeplechase but the parade event for the Bels was the 400m hurdles. No fewer than three of our club-men had made it through to the final: Rawlinson, Levy and Ridgeon, and this in spite of the fact that they had already all faced each…
